verdict.rationale: GitHub documents GitHub Actions as a first-party way to "automate, customize, and execute your software development workflows right in your repository," with CI/CD positioning. The evidence never explicitly describes defining event-based triggers or rules, so the event-driven part of the story is only implied. Push protection automatically blocking pushes that contain secrets is a narrow, fixed rule rather than user-defined automation. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of event triggers (push, PR, issue events) and rule/condition definition, any AI-native rule authoring, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
